Castilla-La Mancha (Castilla-La Mancha) — Guida di Viaggio Spagna: Cosa Vedere, Trasporti e Cucina

Toledo Imperial Historic Center, Cuenca Hanging Houses (Casas Colgadas), Consuegra & Campo de Criptana windmills, Almagro Corral de Comedias. AVE Avant high-speed shuttles from Madrid Puerta de Atocha to Toledo (33 min), Ciudad Real and Cuenca (55 min).

RegioneCastilla-La Mancha (Castilla-La Mancha)
Hub PrincipaleToledo Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail)
Tutte le Città919

Come Arrivare e Muoversi

AVE Avant high-speed shuttles from Madrid Puerta de Atocha to Toledo (33 min), Ciudad Real and Cuenca (55 min).
